spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))

SELECT source_country AS country, count(*) AS alerts
FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%')) AND source_country <> ''
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT substring(serialized FROM '"key":"target_fqdn","value":"([^"]*)"') AS service,
       count(*) AS events
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND serialized LIKE '%"key":"target_fqdn"%' AND ((${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${net:sqlstring} = '') OR alert_events IN (SELECT id FROM alerts a2 WHERE (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(a2.source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR a2.source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT source_as_name AS network, count(*) AS alerts
FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%')) AND source_as_name <> ''
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT a.source_ip AS "IP", a.source_country AS "CC",
       a.source_as_name AS "Network", count(*) AS "Hits",
       count(DISTINCT a.scenario) AS "Scenarios", MAX(a.created_at) AS "Last seen",
       (SELECT d.type FROM decisions d WHERE d.value = a.source_ip AND d.until > now() ORDER BY d.until DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Decision"
FROM alerts a WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(a.source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR a.source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))
GROUP BY a.source_ip, a.source_country, a.source_as_name
ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT substring(serialized FROM '"key":"http_path","value":"([^"]*)"') AS "Path",
       count(*) AS "Hits"
FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND serialized LIKE '%"key":"http_path"%' AND ((${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${net:sqlstring} = '') OR alert_events IN (SELECT id FROM alerts a2 WHERE (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(a2.source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR a2.source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Hits" DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT a.created_at AS "Time", a.source_ip AS "IP", a.source_country AS "CC",
       a.source_as_name AS "Network",
       REPLACE(REPLACE(a.scenario, 'crowdsecurity/', ''), 'LePresidente/', '') AS "Scenario",
       COALESCE((SELECT d.type FROM decisions d WHERE d.value = a.source_ip AND d.until > now() ORDER BY d.until DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Decision",
       substring(mu.value FROM '^\["((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"') AS "URL / path",
       a.events_count AS "Events", a.capacity AS "Capacity"
FROM alerts a
LEFT JOIN meta mu ON mu.alert_metas = a.id AND mu.key = 'target_uri'
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(a.source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR a.source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT m.machine_id AS agent, count(*) AS alerts
FROM alerts a JOIN machines m ON m.id = a.machine_alerts
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(a.source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR a.source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))
GROUP BY m.machine_id ORDER BY alerts DESC

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (split_part(name, '@', 1))
         split_part(name, '@', 1) AS "Bouncer", type AS "Type", version AS "Version",
         last_pull AS "Last pull"
  FROM bouncers WHERE NOT revoked
  ORDER BY split_part(name, '@', 1), last_pull DESC NULLS LAST
) b ORDER BY "Last pull" DESC NULLS LAST

WITH ag AS (
  SELECT m.machine_id AS name, COUNT(a.id) AS n,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC, m.machine_id) AS rn
  FROM machines m
  LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a.machine_alerts = m.id AND $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND a.scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(a.source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR a.source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))
  GROUP BY m.machine_id
), bo AS (
  SELECT split_part(name, '@', 1) AS name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(last_pull) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
  FROM bouncers WHERE NOT revoked
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM ag WHERE rn=1),' ') AS a1_name, (SELECT n FROM ag WHERE rn=1) AS a1,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM ag WHERE rn=2),' ') AS a2_name, (SELECT n FROM ag WHERE rn=2) AS a2,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM ag WHERE rn=3),' ') AS a3_name, (SELECT n FROM ag WHERE rn=3) AS a3,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM ag WHERE rn=4),' ') AS a4_name, (SELECT n FROM ag WHERE rn=4) AS a4,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM ag WHERE rn=5),' ') AS a5_name, (SELECT n FROM ag WHERE rn=5) AS a5,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM ag WHERE rn=6),' ') AS a6_name, (SELECT n FROM ag WHERE rn=6) AS a6,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ag) > 6 THEN CONCAT('+ ', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ag) - 6, ' more agents (see Detections by agent)') ELSE ' ' END AS a_more,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n), 0) FROM ag)::bigint AS total,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM decisions WHERE until > now() AND origin = 'crowdsec') AS enforced,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM bo WHERE rn=1),' ') AS b1_name,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM bo WHERE rn=2),' ') AS b2_name,
  COALESCE((SELECT name FROM bo WHERE rn=3),' ') AS b3_name,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bo) > 3 THEN CONCAT('+ ', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bo) - 3, ' more (see Bouncers)') ELSE ' ' END AS b_more

text.fixed: alerts from all agents in range
each bouncer pulls decisions from the LAPI and enforces them
● Agent number — alerts this agent raised, in the selected time range
● CrowdSec LAPI — total alerts from all agents, same range
● Decisions — distinct IPs blocked or shown a captcha right now by these agents' own detections (live, not time-filtered; the CAPI community blocklist is excluded)

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT source_ip) FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))

SELECT count(DISTINCT source_country) FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%')) AND source_country <> ''
SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM decisions WHERE type = 'ban' AND origin = 'crowdsec' AND until > now() AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(value) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring}))
SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM decisions WHERE type = 'captcha' AND until > now() AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(value) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring}))

SELECT count(*) FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario ILIKE '%cve%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))

SELECT source_latitude AS latitude, source_longitude AS longitude,
       source_ip AS ip,
       COALESCE((SELECT d.type FROM decisions d WHERE d.value = source_ip AND d.until > now() ORDER BY d.until DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS decision,
       count(*) AS alerts, source_country AS country, source_as_name AS network
FROM alerts
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%')) AND source_latitude IS NOT NULL AND source_latitude <> 0
      AND ('$decided' = '0' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decisions d
                                       WHERE d.value = source_ip AND d.until > now()))
GROUP BY source_ip, source_latitude, source_longitude, source_country, source_as_name

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), count(*) AS alerts
FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(scenario, 'crowdsecurity/', ''), 'LePresidente/', '') AS scenario,
       count(*) AS alerts
FROM alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scenario NOT LIKE 'update :%' AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR LOWER(source_ip) = LOWER(${ip:sqlstring})) AND (${net:sqlstring} = '' OR source_as_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', ${net:sqlstring}, '%'))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY alerts DESC LIMIT 15
